title: Physics Informed Priors for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials with Uncertainty Quantification
title_zh: 具有不确定性量化的机器学习原子间势的物理学先验知识
summary: 机器学习原子间势的标准不确定性量化方法通常无法量化模型错误指定的影响，尽管它是一个突出的错误来源。为了解决这个问题，错误指定的不确定性方案已经引起了人们的关注，其中逐点最优参数集回归（POPS-Regression）就是其中之一。然而，没有给出对后验分布的物理性的保证，并且与真实误差相比，不确定性估计可以是保守的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种模型错误指定感知方案，该方案基于 POPS 回归，允许用户指定在获得的模型集合中强制执行的物理先验。
abstract: arXiv:2611.09325v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Standard uncertainty quantification methods for machine learning interatomic potentials often fail to quantify the effects of model misspecification despite its prominence as a source of error. To combat this, misspecification-aware uncertainty schemes have been gaining attention, pointwise optimal parameter set regression (POPS-Regression) among them. However, no guarantees on the physicality of the posterior distribution are given and uncertainty estimates can be conservative compared to the true error. To combat this, we present a model misspecification aware scheme that builds on POPS-Regression by allowing users to specify physical priors that are enforced across the obtained ensemble of models. This allows the user to incorporate misspecification-aware uncertainties without compromising on physical properties. The scheme is applicable to any physical quantity that can be represented by a convex set of parameters and so is robust for a wide variety of static properties which can help inform dynamical simulations. Here, we demonstrate the scheme for phononic vibrations and elastic properties. The scheme is also applied to both linear and message-passing neural network potentials by exploiting the linearity available in both architectures; for neural network potentials we approximate the readout layer as a linear model based on fixed non-linear features. The versatility of the method provides an alternative to hand-crafted or active learning approaches to data-set construction to correct physical failures by adding data thus reducing the computational overhead for designing potentials for specific applications.

title: A Machine Learning study of the two-dimensional antiferromagnetic Q-state Potts model on the square lattice
title_zh: 方格上二维反铁磁Q状态Potts模型的机器学习研究
summary: 利用监督神经网络（NN）研究了 Q=2、3、4、5 和 6 方格上二维反铁磁 Q 态 Potts 模型的临界现象。传统的监督和无监督神经网络要么失败，要么难以识别这些模型的正确关键行为。值得注意的是，尽管这里使用的神经网络是用特定的固定类型训练集进行训练的，该训练集不包含有关所考虑模型的信息（Q = 2 除外），但它们正确地计算了所研究的物理系统的临界温度。特别是，NN 结果令人信服地表明，Q=3 模型仅在零温度下至关重要，而 Q=4,5,6 模型在所有温度下都保持无序。
abstract: arXiv:2512.06762v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The critical phenomena of 2D antiferromagnetic Q-state Potts model on the square lattice with Q=2,3,4,5 and 6 are investigated using supervised neural networks (NN). Conventional supervised and unsupervised NNs either fail or have difficulty in identifying the correct critical behaviors of these models. Remarkably, despite the fact that the NNs employed here are trained with a particular fixed type training set which contains no information about the considered models (except for Q=2), they correctly compute the critical temperatures for the studied physical systems. Particularly, the NN outcomes suggest convincingly that the Q=3 model is critical only at zero temperature and Q=4,5,6 models remain disordered at all temperatures. Apart from the studied models, our NNs trained with exactly the same training set have successfully determined the critical temperature(s) and the nature of the associated phase transition(s) of another physical system differing dramatically from those considered here. Therefore, our NN has the potential to be a universally applicable NN model in studying phase transitions.

title: Active learning and explicit electrostatics enable accurate modeling of electrolytes
title_zh: 主动学习和显式静电学能够实现电解质的精确建模
summary: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 将近乎从头计算的精度与经典力场的计算效率相结合，使其成为分子液体和电解质建模的有前途的工具。它们的预测准确性在很大程度上取决于训练集的多样性，而静电的显式处理越来越被认为是提高其性能的重要因素。在这项工作中，我们通过将短程矩张量势 (MTP) 与静电增强 MTP（包括固定电荷和环境相关电荷模型）进行比较，评估了结合显式静电和原子电荷环境依赖性的影响。
abstract: arXiv:2510.03479v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) combine near-ab initio accuracy with the computational efficiency of classical force fields, making them promising tools for modeling molecular liquids and electrolytes. Their predictive accuracy depends strongly on the diversity of the training set, while the explicit treatment of electrostatics is increasingly recognized as an important factor in improving their performance. In this work, we assess the impact of incorporating explicit electrostatics and environment-dependence of atomic charges by comparing short-ranged Moment Tensor Potentials (MTPs) with electrostatics-augmented MTPs, including fixed-charge and environment-dependent charge models. To this end, we employ D-optimality-based active learning (AL) to train short-ranged MTPs and extend the AL procedure, previously unavailable for long-range electrostatics-augmented MTPs, to these models, enabling largely automated generation of diverse training sets for pure ethylene carbonate (EC) and ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), their mixtures, and LiPF6 solutions. For EC, EMC, and their mixtures, electrostatics-augmented MTPs achieve accuracy comparable to or better than that of their short-ranged counterparts while requiring fewer machine-learned parameters. For LiPF6 solutions, however, a notable improvement in accuracy is achieved only with environment-dependent charges, which also enhance stability in large-scale molecular dynamics simulations, unlike the fixed-charge model. The resulting short-ranged MTPs and environment-dependent-charge models reproduce experimental densities with mean absolute deviations of 0.2-6% and ionic conductivities with deviations of 11-15%, while capturing the experimentally observed temperature dependence of conductivity.

title: Inverse design of superconductors and semiconductors with differentiable foundation models
title_zh: 具有可微基础模型的超导体和半导体的逆向设计
summary: 设计具有目标特性的晶体需要同时选择其元素、化学计量和原子结构，但梯度仅存在于连续结构变量。我们引入了可微的 Equiformer 快速有效原子理论 (DEFEAT)，它使预训练的 EquiformerV3 基础模型接受连续的物种权重和位点占用，而无需对分数数据进行重新训练，从而实现基于梯度的材料优化。来自微调属性模型的梯度和机器学习的能量惩罚然后在单个优化中指导成分、原子计数、原子位置和晶格向量的更新。
abstract: arXiv:2611.09572v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing a crystal for a target property requires choosing its elements, stoichiometry, and atomic structure together, yet gradients exist only for the continuous structural variables. We introduce differentiable Equiformer fast effective-atom theory (DEFEAT), which lets a pretrained EquiformerV3 foundation model accept continuous species weights and site occupancies without retraining on fractional data, thereby enabling gradient-based materials optimization. Gradients from fine-tuned property models and a machine-learned energy penalty then guide updates to composition, atom count, atomic positions, and lattice vectors in a single optimization. In a search for phonon-mediated superconductors, density-functional perturbation theory on 45 structurally novel designs gives isotropic Allen-Dynes critical temperatures above 10 K for 39; the highest is 24.0 K for ZrTiNb2CN3, and H4LiPd3 (23.2 K) lies on the static DFT hull. In searches for photovoltaic absorbers, SCAN calculations confirm ten novel crystal structures with band gaps within 20% of a 1.34 eV target on their respective raw or empirically corrected scales, all within 70 meV/atom of the DFT hull, and show that the systematic gap error of the training functional propagates into the designs unless the objective corrects for it. Quasiharmonic free energies from machine-learned potentials further show that finite-temperature competition with solid phases can reorder candidates relative to the static hull.

title: SimPoly: Simulation of polymers with machine learning force fields derived from first principles
title_zh: SimPoly：利用源自第一原理的机器学习力场模拟聚合物
summary: 作者开发了一种机器学习力场，仅根据量子化学数据进行训练，可以重现测量的关键聚合物特性，例如密度和玻璃化转变温度。
abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 09 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-78736-x The authors develop a machine learning force field trained only on quantum-chemical data that can reproduce measured key polymer properties such as densities and glass transition temperatures.

title: TopoSHAP: Shapley for Explainable and Efficient Topological Deep Learning
title_zh: TopoSHAP：Shapley 用于可解释且高效的拓扑深度学习
summary: 拓扑深度学习 (TDL) 将图（例如分子或社交网络）的学习扩展到高阶结构（例如分子中的环或社交网络中的基团）。解释哪些结构驱动模型的预测，以及哪些架构组件对其性能最重要，仍然具有挑战性。我们引入了 TopoSHAP，这是一个高效且通用的解释框架，可以解决跨拓扑域和模型架构的问题。 TopoSHAP-cell 将 Shapley 值分配给拓扑数据单元并提取紧凑的解释。这些解释在 GraphXAI 基准数据上匹配或优于基于图形的对应解释，同时运行速度提高了 112 倍。
abstract: arXiv:2611.08789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological deep learning (TDL) extends learning on graphs, such as molecules or social networks, to higher-order structures, such as rings in a molecule or groups in a social network. Explaining which of these structures drive a model's predictions, and which architectural components matter most for its performance, remains challenging. We introduce TopoSHAP, an efficient and general explanation framework that addresses both questions across topological domains and model architectures. TopoSHAP-cell assigns Shapley values to topological data cells and extracts compact explanations. These explanations match or outperform graph-based counterparts on GraphXAI benchmark data while running up to 112× faster. They also reveal advantageous topological feature design, leading to measured improvements in explanation recovery and predictive accuracy. On the architecture side, TopoSHAP-neighbor explains how neighborhoods contribute to model performance, and turns these evaluations into a backward-elimination search that identifies smaller, competitive architectures early in training. This is up to 11.3× cheaper than traditional TDL training sweeps.

title: Emergent Low-Dimensional Topological Dynamics Dictate Generalization and Escape Mechanics in Billion-Parameter Neural Networks
title_zh: 新兴的低维拓扑动力学决定了十亿参数神经网络中的泛化和逃逸机制
summary: 现代超参数化神经网络的显着泛化挑战了经典统计学习的界限。在这里，我们确定十亿参数模型中的优化轨迹不会均匀地采样环境维度 R^N；相反，它们被动态地约束到低维执行子流形 Mₑₓₑc（根据经验观察到的有效维度 dₑff le 12）。通过为参数空间配备正则化的 Hessian 度量 gᵢⱼ = nablaᵢ nablaⱼ L + ϵ δᵢⱼ 并分析损失子级别集上的随机 Langevin 扩散，我们得出了基于投影子空间持久同源性的严格拓扑泛化界限。
abstract: arXiv:2611.08502v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The remarkable generalization of modern over-parameterized neural networks defies classical statistical learning bounds. Here we establish that optimization trajectories in billion-parameter models do not sample the ambient dimension R^N homogeneously; instead, they are dynamically constrained to a low-dimensional execution submanifold Mₑₓₑc (with empirically observed effective dimension dₑff le 12). By equipping the parameter space with a regularized Hessian metric gᵢⱼ = nablaᵢ nablaⱼ L + ϵ δᵢⱼ and analyzing stochastic Langevin diffusion on loss sublevel sets, we derive a rigorous Topological Generalization Bound grounded in projected subspace persistent homology. Furthermore, by linking Morse index transitions to Betti number annihilation (β₁ → 0), we formulate an exact mathematical mechanism for exponential escape from strict saddles under anisotropic noise. We validate our framework across 80+ architectures (ResNets, Vision Transformers, and 7B LLMs). To bridge theoretical topology with computational feasibility, we resolve the curse of dimensionality by computing projected persistent homology proxies via randomized Lanczos iterations restricted strictly within active Hessian subspaces. Building upon this mathematical foundation, we introduce Topological-Adaptive Optimization (Top-SGD and Top-AdamW)---a family of wrapper algorithms that dynamically modulate learning rates using active curvature signatures. Extensive benchmarks demonstrate a 14.1% reduction in total wall-clock training time on ImageNet with all computational and memory overheads fully accounted for. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/imslab-research/Topological-SGD.

title: Symmetry-Gated Sliding: Decoupling Interlayer Translation from Polarization Reversal in Boron Nitride Ferroelectrics
title_zh: 对称门控滑动：氮化硼铁电体中极化反转的层间平移解耦
summary: 滑动铁电体中电场驱动的极化切换取决于周围结构如何适应局部层间运动。然而，变化矢量场下的滑动、畴壁（DW）传播和集体域演化之间的关系仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明局部对称性控制着场感生力和层间滑动之间的耦合，而 DW 连接性则决定了局部运动如何促进网络域转换。这些效应在三个结构尺度上进行了研究，从单域和孤立的 DW 到重建的莫尔网络。我们利用分子动力学和机器学习原子间势（结合了场相关电焓）研究双层六方氮化硼 (h-BN)。
abstract: arXiv:2611.09025v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric-field-driven polarization switching in sliding ferroelectrics depends on how local interlayer motion is accommodated by the surrounding structure. Yet the relationship between sliding, domain-wall (DW) propagation, and collective domain evolution under changing vector fields remains unclear. Here, we show that local symmetry governs the coupling between field-induced forces and interlayer sliding, while DW connectivity determines how local motion contributes to net domain conversion. These effects are examined across three structural scales, from monodomains and isolated DWs to reconstructed moire networks. We investigate bilayer hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) using molecular dynamics with a machine-learning interatomic potential that incorporates field-dependent electric enthalpy. An initially monodomain bilayer switches through directional wrinkling and interlayer sliding, while the barrier along a constrained flat path remains finite. Pre-existing DWs propagate with velocities governed by their shear and tensile character, and an additional in-plane field tunes wall velocity and width according to its orientation. In reconstructed triangular moire networks, shared junctions and boundary curvature mediate domain evolution and recovery after field removal or reversal. Most strikingly, a rotating in-plane field translates the layers and displaces the moiré nodes by approximately 1 AA yet leaves the AB/BA domain-area ratio without detectable change, because threefold connectivity cancels the contributions of individual walls. We term this response polarization-silent sliding. These results distinguish local sliding, DW translation, and net domain conversion as different responses to electric fields and establish how local structural symmetry and DW connectivity shape their selective control.

title: Fortuitous Cancellation of Competing Effects in the Free Energy of Water Autoionization: Long-Range Electrostatics, System Size, and Nuclear Quantum Effects
title_zh: 水自电离自由能中竞争效应的偶然抵消：长程静电、系统尺寸和核量子效应
summary: 对于化学来说，很少有分子过程比水的自电离更重要，其平衡常数 K_w 约为 10⁻14，是酸碱平衡和生命化学的基础。然而，形成和分离离子的自由能成本的分子起源仍不完全清楚。由于难以足够详细地模拟水反应性，解释它的努力受到限制。在这里，我们将机器学习原子间势（MLIP）与光谱自适应偏置力增强采样相结合，将质子转移和水线配置与底层自由能景观连接起来。我们确定了长程静电、系统尺寸、温度和核量子运动对预测电离热力学的竞争影响。
abstract: arXiv:2611.08874v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Few molecular processes are more fundamental to chemistry than the autoionization of water, whose equilibrium constant, K_w approx 10⁻¹⁴, underlies acid-base equilibria and the chemistry of life. Yet the molecular origins of the free energy cost of forming and separating ions remain incompletely understood. Efforts to explain it have been limited by the difficulty of modeling water reactivity in sufficient detail. Here we combine machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) with spectral adaptive biasing force enhanced sampling to connect proton transfer and water wire configurations to the underlying free energy landscape. We identify competing influences of long-range electrostatics, system size, temperature, and nuclear quantum motion on the predicted ionization thermodynamics. The free energy surface extends from neutral water to ions separated beyond the solvent-separated ion pair (SSIP). It reveals a transition state in which a proton is shared between the second and third molecules of a three-membered water wire. The contact ion pair is unstable and the SSIP only weakly metastable, so determining pK_w requires sampling longer wires. Long-range electrostatics raise the free energy at ion separations beyond 3,mathrmmathringA. Models with comparable force errors give substantially different free energy profiles in this region. Increasing system size lowers the calculated pK_w, while nuclear quantum effects bring it closer to experiment and reproduce the higher pK_w of D₂O relative to H₂O. These results establish a baseline for interpreting thermodynamic results from MLIP simulations in which charged and polar groups react and diffuse in finite cells. Our analysis also explains how cancellation among competing effects can yield ionization constants close to experiment even when simulations omit several physical contributions.

title: From local learning to global electronic properties in large-scale systems
title_zh: 从本地学习到大规模系统中的全局电子特性
summary: 来自局部原子环境的机器学习为电子结构提供了一条有效的途径，但评估大型系统中的全局电子特性仍然需要大量计算。在这里，我们使用根据预测密度构建的 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量将真实空间电荷密度学习与随机传播结合起来。该框架避免了目标系统自洽迭代和显式对角化，而分层分块可以在有限的 GPU 内存内实现密集网格推理。我们演示了 100 万个 Si 原子的态密度计算以及超过 10 万个原子的光学和传输计算，而无需为每个属性训练单独的模型。
abstract: arXiv:2611.09153v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning from local atomic environments offers an efficient route to electronic structure, but evaluating global electronic properties in large systems remains computationally demanding. Here we combine real space charge density learning with stochastic propagation using Kohn-Sham Hamiltonians constructed from the predicted densities. The framework avoids target system self-consistent iterations and explicit diagonalization, while hierarchical blocking enables dense grid inference within limited GPU memory. We demonstrate density of states calculations for one million Si atoms and optical and transport calculations for over one hundred thousand atoms, without training separate models for each property. This framework extends the practical scale of electronic structure calculations within Kohn-Sham DFT, opening opportunities to investigate how atomic structure governs electronic, optical and transport properties at length scales relevant to real materials and devices.

title: Universal Hamiltonian learning with rotational and basis equivariance
title_zh: 具有旋转和基方差的通用哈密顿学习
summary: 深度学习有可能通过提高电子结构计算的效率和可扩展性来改变计算材料的研究。局部原子轨道基中的哈密顿矩阵是深度学习电子结构的一个有希望的目标，但实施旋转等方差可能在计算上花费很大，并且矩阵取决于基集的选择。在这里，我们引入了DeepH-2 ，这是一个物理引导的神经网络框架，通过局部坐标公式降低了执行旋转等方差的计算成本，并通过将共享的潜在哈密顿函数映射到目标原子轨道基，结合了基方差。DeepH-2在不同的材料数据集上实现了亚meV测试集误差，并展示了跨材料尺寸的可转移性。
abstract: arXiv:2401.17015v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Deep learning has the potential to transform computational materials research by making electronic-structure calculations more efficient and scalable. The Hamiltonian matrix in the localized atomic-orbital basis is a promising target for deep-learning electronic structure, yet enforcing rotational equivariance can be computationally costly, and the matrix depends on the choice of basis set. Here we introduce DeepH-2, a physics-guided neural-network framework that reduces the computational cost of enforcing rotational equivariance through a local-coordinate formulation and incorporates basis equivariance by mapping a shared latent Hamiltonian to the target atomic-orbital basis. DeepH-2 achieves sub-meV test-set error on a diverse materials dataset and demonstrates transferability across material dimensions. These results highlight the value of encoding physics priors into deep-learning electronic structure models, and pave the way for developing the electronic-structure foundation models.

title: Strain-Dependent Ionic Transport in Li3YCl6 Solid Electrolytes
title_zh: Li3YCl6 固体电解质中应变相关的离子传输
summary: 固态电池需要电解质在功能电池的机械环境下维持高离子电导率。由堆压、界面晶格失配以及更重要的是电化学循环引起的晶格应变可以增强或抑制固体电解质中的Li⁺传输，但它如何与Li3YCl6中的潜在扩散机制耦合仍然知之甚少。使用 Li3YCl6 卤化物超离子导体，我们通过由原子团簇扩展 (ACE) 机器学习原子间势驱动的大规模分子动力学模拟来解决这个问题，该模型是根据第一性原理数据训练的。 ACE 模型忠实地再现了 Li3YCl6 的实验和从头开始的结构、机械和输运特性。
abstract: arXiv:2605.05603v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Solid-state batteries require electrolytes that sustain high ionic conductivity under the mechanical environment of a functioning cell. Lattice strain, arising from stack pressure, lattice mismatch at interfaces, and more importantly electrochemical cycling, can either enhance or suppress Li⁺ transport in solid electrolytes, yet how it couples to the underlying diffusion mechanism in Li3YCl6 remains poorly understood. Using Li3YCl6 halide superionic conductor, we address this with large-scale molecular dynamics simulations driven by an Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) machine learning interatomic potential trained on first-principles data. The ACE model faithfully reproduces experimental and ab initio structural, mechanical, and transport properties of Li3YCl6. Extending the simulations to high temperature reveals a crossover from predominantly one-dimensional hopping at low temperature toward diffusion through a connected three-dimensional pathway network at high temperature. Strain substantially modulates diffusivity: tensile strain enhances it while compressive strain suppresses it. Free-breakpoint model selection resolves two Arrhenius regimes for most strain states, and the fitted T_c varies nonmonotonically with strain. Strain modifies the effective activation energies and the accessibility of diffusion pathways in a temperature-dependent manner. These results quantify the strain sensitivity of ionic conductivity and diffusion pathways in Li3YCl6 solid-state electrolytes.

title: Reversible Interchain Associations Dominate Plateau Elasticity in Conjugated Polymers
title_zh: 可逆链间缔合主导共轭聚合物的平台弹性
summary: 模量平台被广泛认为是均聚物熔体中拓扑缠结的标志，并已用于识别半柔性共轭聚合物中的缠结。使用区域随机聚（3-烷基噻吩）作为模型系统，我们表明它们的平台弹性通过与链段和末端动力学解耦的阿伦尼乌斯过程松弛，在机械扰动下持续重组，并随着侧链长度系统地变化。这些行为很难与纯粹的拓扑纠缠图相协调，而是支持由可逆链间关联主导的瞬态网络，与共轭主链片段之间的 π-π 相互作用一致。因此，结果表明，平台弹性本身并不能唯一地识别共轭聚合物中的拓扑缠结。
abstract: arXiv:2611.09810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The modulus plateau is widely regarded as a hallmark of topological entanglement in homopolymer melts and has been used to identify entanglement in semiflexible conjugated polymers. Using regiorandom poly(3-alkylthiophenes) as a model system, we show that their plateau elasticity relaxes through an Arrhenius process decoupled from segmental and terminal dynamics, reorganizes persistently under mechanical perturbation, and varies systematically with side-chain length. These behaviors are hard to reconcile with a purely topological-entanglement picture and instead support a transient network dominated by reversible interchain associations, consistent with π-π interactions between conjugated backbone segments. The results thus demonstrate that plateau elasticity alone does not uniquely identify topological entanglement in conjugated polymers. More broadly, they identify the strength and lifetime of interchain association as molecular design parameters linking backbone packing to stress relaxation, viscoelastic properties, and processability in conjugated polymers, complementing their established role in electronic structure and charge transport.

title: Quantum-walk measurements with sequential imaging of the same atomic sample
title_zh: 对同一原子样品进行连续成像的量子行走测量
summary: 我们展示了同一超冷原子样品的顺序单原子分辨成像，并将该技术应用于光学晶格中的量子行走测量。在量子气体显微镜实验中，荧光成像提供了原子分布的微观信息，但通过光子散射引起运动加热，使得很难在后续的量子动力学中重复使用相同的样品。为了克服这一限制，我们应用拉曼边带冷却，并针对成像后冷却优化了参数，从而能够对同一样品进行连续的单原子分辨测量。通过机器学习优化冷却参数，我们在多个成像周期中实现了高保真度。为了证明这项技术的能力，我们测量了光学晶格中单个原子的一维量子行走。
abstract: arXiv:2611.09618v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate sequential single-atom-resolved imaging of the same ultracold atomic sample and apply this technique to quantum-walk measurements in an optical lattice. In quantum gas microscope experiments, fluorescence imaging provides microscopic information on atomic distributions but induces motional heating through photon scattering, making it difficult to reuse the same sample for subsequent quantum dynamics. To overcome this limitation, we apply Raman sideband cooling with parameters optimized for post-imaging cooling, enabling sequential single-atom-resolved measurements of the same sample. By optimizing the cooling parameters with machine learning, we achieve high fidelity over multiple imaging cycles. To demonstrate the capability of this technique, we measure one-dimensional quantum walks of single atoms in an optical lattice. By determining the initial atomic positions from fluorescence images, we extract quantum-walk transition probabilities without requiring deterministic preparation of the initial atomic positions. The observed dynamics agree with numerical simulations of quantum walks of single atoms. Our method provides a route toward reducing experimental overhead in quantum gas microscope studies requiring repeated acquisition of spatially resolved correlation data.

title: Quantum dynamics via score matching on Bohmian trajectories
title_zh: 通过波姆轨迹分数匹配的量子动力学
summary: 作者：王雷 波姆力学将量子运动描述为由分数（对数密度的梯度）引导的确定性轨迹。在这里，神经网络学习其所驱动的轨迹的得分，将薛定谔方程转变为自洽的归一化流。这种方法为现代生成模型开启了实时量子动力学。 [APS 开放科学。 1, 000209] 发布于 2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一
abstract: Author(s): Lei Wang Bohmian mechanics describes quantum motion as deterministic trajectories steered by the score — the gradient of the log-density. Here, a neural network learns that score on the very trajectories it drives, turning the Schrödinger equation into a self-consistent normalizing flow. This approach opens real-time quantum dynamics to modern generative modeling. [APS Open Sci. 1, 000209] Published Mon Nov 09, 2026

title: Low-Rank Iteration for Efficient Calculations of Topological Surface States
title_zh: 拓扑表面态高效计算的低阶迭代
summary: 表面态是拓扑相的标志，其有效计算对于拓扑表征至关重要。传统的超胞方法（SCM）将半无限系统近似为有限周期系统，但存在计算成本高、人工表面间耦合以及带边缘附近收敛速度慢的问题。最近，半无限系统的边界问题已被改写为块三对角方程，并通过循环约简法（CRM）和传递矩阵法（TMM）来求解。然而，这些方法仍然是资源密集型的，因为细网格离散化会产生非常大的矩阵。
abstract: arXiv:2611.09165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Surface states are hallmarks of topological phases, and their efficient computation is crucial for topology characterization. Conventional supercell methods (SCM) approximate semi-infinite systems as finite periodic ones, but suffer from high computational cost, artificial inter-surface coupling, and slow convergence near band edges. Recently, boundary problems for semi-infinite systems have been recast as block-tridiagonal equations and solved by the cyclic reduction method (CRM) and the transfer matrix method (TMM). However, these approaches remain resource-intensive, as fine-mesh discretization produces very large matrices. Recognizing the intrinsic sparsity and low rank of these matrices, we develop a low-rank iterative method (LIM) with stochastic trace estimation that substantially reduces complexity and memory without sacrificing accuracy, while remaining straightforwardly parallelizable. Benchmarks on 2D and 3D topological systems show orders-of-magnitude acceleration over CRM and TMM. LIM extends readily to heterostructures, defective interfaces, and non-Hermitian systems, providing an efficient platform for topological and plasmonic surface phenomena.

title: Electronic Bands and Altermagnetic State Modulation in a Se-Rich In₂Se₄/Cr₂SeO Heterostructure
title_zh: 富硒 In2Se4/Cr2SeO 异质结构中的电子能带和交变磁态调制
summary: 二维范德华 (vdW) 异质结构为通过界面电荷重新分布和轨道杂化来设计电子特性提供了一个多功能平台。在这项工作中，提出了一种富含 Se 的 In2Se4/Cr2SeO vdW 异质结构，并使用密度泛函理论进行了研究。 In 2 Se 4 层充当电子活性界面，其中增强的硒亚晶格提供能够与交变磁性Cr 2 SeO的Cr-3d衍生态相互作用的Se-p态。使用1×1×1 In 2 Se 4 单层和应变（x 方向拉伸，y 方向压缩）1×2×1 Cr 2 SeO 电池构建超级电池。
abstract: Two-dimensional van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures provide a versatile platform for engineering electronic properties through interfacial charge redistribution and orbital hybridization. In this work, a Se-rich-designated In₂Se₄/Cr₂SeO vdW heterostructure is proposed and investigated using density functional theory. The In₂Se₄ layer serves as an electronically active interface in which the enhanced selenium sublattice provides Se-p states capable of interacting with the Cr-3d-derived states of an altermagnetic Cr₂SeO. A 1×1×1 In₂Se₄ monolayer and a strained (tensile in x and compressive in y) 1×2×1 Cr₂SeO cell were used to construct a supercell. The structural stability of the heterostructure is first evaluated through relaxation. The electronic properties are then characterized using spin-resolved band structures, projected density of states, orbital-resolved electronic states, and spatial charge density. The calculations reveal that interlayer coupling substantially modifies the electronic states near the Fermi level while retaining the characteristic spin-dependent structure of the Cr₂SeO layer. Overall, the heterostructure exhibits momentum-dependent semi-metallic/semiconducting behavior with strongly spin-selective local gaps. Se displacement in the In₂Se₄ monolayer acts as a symmetry and electrostatic control parameter that modifies the spin channels differently at different k-points. The resulting momentum-selective modification of Cr-derived states demonstrates the potential of Se-rich chalcogenide interfaces for tailoring the electronic structure of two-dimensional altermagnets. These findings suggest this heterostructure as a promising platform for investigating interfacial spin-dependent phenomena, provide insight into low-dimensional magnetic materials, and provide a theoretical foundation for nanoscale spintronic applications.

title: Driving Atomic Spins through Their Substrate Electrons
title_zh: 通过基底电子驱动原子自旋
summary: 对表面上单个自旋的相干控制依赖于用绝缘膜将它们与基底解耦，这保护了自旋，但也消除了解决它的任何电子手段。在这里，我们证明局部电势可以通过基底电子本身驱动吸附原子自旋。精确的互易关系确定了扭矩，该扭矩等于力矩旋转时局部电子密度的变化；因此，驱动图是可以独立测量的基态特性。这种关系还意味着尖锐的选择规则，因为点接触自旋、自旋 1/2 和半整数自旋的中心过渡仍然是黑暗的。在普通金属上，负责驱动的杂化也会破坏相干性，但在超导体上，驱动仍然存在，而基底阻尼仅限于子间隙跃迁。
abstract: arXiv:2611.09499v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent control of single spins on surfaces has relied on decoupling them from the substrate with insulating films, which protects the spin but also removes any electronic means of addressing it. Here we show that a local electric potential can drive an adatom spin through the substrate electrons themselves. An exact reciprocity relation fixes the torque, which equals the change of the local electron density when the moment rotates; the drive map is thus a ground-state property that can be measured independently. The relation also implies sharp selection rules, since point-contact spins, spin-1/2 and the central transition of half-integer spins remain dark. On a normal metal the hybridization responsible for the drive also destroys coherence, but on a superconductor the drive survives while substrate damping is confined to subgap transitions. For atomically sharp tips we find Rabi frequencies of several MHz at RF amplitudes of tens of mV, with substrate-limited linewidths below 0.1~MHz, so that strong hybridization, usually the enemy of spin coherence, becomes an asset.

title: Exploring Variational Regularization of Krylov Subspaces
title_zh: 探索 Krylov 子空间的变分正则化
summary: Krylov 子空间方法可以有效地近似多体哈密顿量的极值本征态和本征值，但非正交基可能会受到病态条件的影响。这一挑战在量子计算中被放大，因为直接状态访问和直接正交化是不可用的。我们研究了一种类似 Krylov 的变分框架，它迭代优化参数化的状态序列以模拟 Lanczos 式的耦合，同时惩罚线性依赖性。
abstract: arXiv:2611.09229v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Krylov subspace methods efficiently approximate extremal eigenstates and eigenvalues of many-body Hamiltonians, but non-orthogonal bases can suffer from ill-conditioning. This challenge is amplified in quantum computing, where direct state access and thus straightforward orthogonalization are unavailable. We investigate a variational Krylov-like framework that iteratively optimizes a parametrized sequence of states to mimic Lanczos-like couplings while penalizing linear dependencies. Analyzed against exact Krylov and Lanczos on a finite Anderson impurity model, ansatz expressivity strongly influences the performance: Hamiltonian-inspired ansätze preserve Krylov-like convergence while improving the conditioning, whereas shallow ansätze remain stable but miss low-energy directions.

title: Learning State Preparation Circuits for Quantum Phases of Matter
title_zh: 物质量子相的学习状态准备电路
summary: 多体基态准备是物理系统仿真中使用的重要子程序。在本文中，我们引入了一个灵活有效的框架，用于获得一大类多体基态的状态准备电路。我们引入了多项式时间经典算法，该算法以O （ 1 ）大小的球上的减小密度矩阵作为输入，并输出准备全局状态的电路。我们介绍了适用于（ i ）短程纠缠态（例如，由浅量子电路在任何维度上准备的状态，更一般地说，可逆状态）和（ ii ）长程纠缠基态（例如，磁盘上的环面代码）的算法。这两种算法都可以证明找到深度渐近最优的电路。
abstract: arXiv:2410.23544v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Many-body ground state preparation is an important subroutine used in the simulation of physical systems. In this paper, we introduce a flexible and efficient framework for obtaining a state preparation circuit for a large class of many-body ground states. We introduce polynomial-time classical algorithms that take reduced density matrices over O(1)-sized balls as inputs, and output a circuit that prepares the global state. We introduce algorithms applicable to (i) short-range entangled states (e.g., states prepared by shallow quantum circuits in any number of dimensions, and more generally, invertible states) and (ii) long-range entangled ground states (e.g., the toric code on a disk). Both algorithms can provably find a circuit whose depth is asymptotically optimal. Our approach uses a variant of the quantum Markov chain condition that remains robust against constant-depth circuits. The robustness of this condition makes our method applicable to a large class of states, whilst ensuring a classically tractable optimization landscape.
